title: Auxiliary leaf rectangles lie within the constraint
statement: Let $p$ be a deterministic two-party communication protocol over input types $X$ (Alice) and $Y$ (Bob), and let $A \subseteq X$ and $B \subseteq Y$. Then every rectangle $R$ in the collection of auxiliary leaf rectangles of $p$ constrained to $A \times B$ satisfies $R \subseteq A \times B$.
hypotheses_covered: p is a protocol over X, Y, α
A is a subset of X
B is a subset of Y
R is a member of the auxiliary leaf rectangles of p relative to A and B
replaced: Every element $R$ of $\texttt{leafRectanglesAux}(p, A, B)$ satisfies $R \subseteq A \times B$.
